rows.whatChanged:
Three changes at the shared Rhode Island host scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs, and nothing in this family's own directory beyond the rebuilt bytes.
(1) THE SPLITTER. The private character-accumulating splitToken at lines 1764-1772 of renderComposedPdf is replaced by createTokenSplitter({ fits: fitsByFontMetrics(font, fontSize, maxWidth) }) from scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/split-token.mjs - the same move FIX21 made for scripts/build-census-v1-ga-host.mjs and the Kentucky host. A route key that exceeds the 468pt column now breaks at its own hyphen and never mid-word, and the host asserts hardSplits === 0 per document so a future key that has no separator to break on fails the build instead of shipping.
(2) THE TRAILER IS OUT OF THE COURT'S BLOCK. In proposedOrderBody the disclaimer and the 'Route:' trailer were the last two lines of the document, which printed them under 'Certification or attestation by the Clerk' - inside the block the page itself says is the court's and is left blank on purpose. They now close the moving party's half of the order, immediately above the dotted rule and ORDER_COURT_BLOCK_NOTICE. Not one character of the decretal block changed.
(3) THE TRAILER PULL-DOWN. renderComposedPdf's block pagination now tags each row with its source line and whether that line is the trailer, and after the layout has settled it pulls the previous block down onto a last page whose every drawn row is trailer. This is the sole-occupant pull-down scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-ok-custom-pleading.mjs already carries, moved onto this host's own block pagination rather than a new scheme: it moves whole blocks only, refuses a move that would not fit, and does nothing on a page that already carries prose.

WHAT THIS FAMILY SHIPPED BEFORE, READ OFF THE DELIVERED BYTES: 8 hard splits per fixture on pages 6, 8, 12 and 13 - '...-stage-2-court-motion-and-affidav' / 'it ;' and '...-stage-3-notice-hearing-and-certif' / 'ied-copies' - and a route-key-only page 8 carrying five drawn lines, all of them the trailer. AFTER: 0 hard splits, 0 route-key-only pages, nothing under the clerk's certification line, 13 pages unchanged; page 8 now opens on the closing paragraph of the notice package ('Two of the findings in that sentence - good moral character, and rehabilitation to the court's satisfaction - are the court's to make...') with the trailer beneath it, and the keys break as '...-court-motion-and-' / 'affidavit' and '...-notice-hearing-and-' / 'certified-copies'.
